Brilliant Stars Trainer Gallery

Released February 25, 2022 · 30 cards

StandardExpanded

Brilliant Stars Trainer Gallery is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on February 25, 2022. It has 30 cards. It includes 25 Pokémon, 5 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
